title: Sensor Aapko Dekhta Nahi, Bas Garmi Mehsoos Karta Hai #shorts
description:
Seedhi pe kadam rakha aur light khud jal gayi! Kaise? Jaaniye HC-SR501 PIR sensor ka poora raaz.
🔥 Body heat se motion kaise pakadta hai
🔍 Fresnel dome aur twin pyroelectric elements ke andar kya hai
🧠 BISS0001 chip signal ko HIGH kaise banata hai
🎛️ Time aur sensitivity pot se 3 se 7 meter ki setting
🔌 Arduino se wiring aur 3.3V output
Aise aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #pirsensor #hcsr501 #arduino #electronics #hindi #motionsensor
